items.front: Who won the 2026 Men's T20 World Cup and how?
items.back: India — beat New Zealand by 96 runs in the final (8 Mar 2026, Ahmedabad); India's 3rd title.
items.examPoint: 2026 Men's T20 World Cup — final result (India beat NZ by 96 runs, 8 Mar 2026, Ahmedabad; India's 3rd title)
items.source: Wikipedia — 2026 ICC Men's T20 World Cup

items.front: Who co-hosted the 2026 Men's T20 World Cup?
items.back: India and Sri Lanka (7 Feb – 8 Mar 2026).
items.examPoint: 2026 Men's T20 World Cup (India-Sri Lanka hosts; India champions)
items.source: Wikipedia — 2026 ICC Men's T20 World Cup

items.front: Who is the 53rd CJI and since when?
items.back: Surya Kant, sworn in 24 Nov 2025 (succeeded B. R. Gavai).
items.examPoint: Chief Justice of India — Surya Kant, 53rd CJI (Nov 2025)

items.front: Vice-President of India (2026)?
items.back: C. P. Radhakrishnan, since 12 Sep 2025; ex-officio Rajya Sabha Chairman.
items.examPoint: Constitutional posts — President, VP, PM, Speaker (2026 incumbents)

items.front: CEC and RBI Governor (2026)?
items.back: CEC Gyanesh Kumar (since 19 Feb 2025); RBI Governor Sanjay Malhotra, 26th (since 11 Dec 2024).

items.front: Union Budget 2026-27 — presenter and date?
items.back: Nirmala Sitharaman, 1 Feb 2026.

items.front: Economic Survey 2025-26 GDP growth figure?
items.back: Real GDP growth FY26 = 7.4%; FY27 outlook 6.8-7.2%.

items.front: Which Act replaced the Income Tax Act 1961 and when?
items.back: Income Tax Act, 2025 — effective 1 April 2026.

items.front: VB-G RAM G — what does it replace and its guarantee?
items.back: Viksit Bharat Guarantee for Rozgar & Ajeevika Mission (Gramin); replaces MGNREGA, raises guarantee to 125 days.

items.front: Padma Awards 2026 — total and split?
items.back: 131 awards: 5 Vibhushan, 13 Bhushan, 113 Shri; no Bharat Ratna in the window.

items.front: Name two 2026 Padma Vibhushan awardees.
items.back: Dharmendra (posthumous), V. S. Achuthanandan (posthumous), N. Rajam, K. T. Thomas, P. Narayanan.

items.front: India's Asia Power Index 2025 rank?
items.back: 3rd (Lowy Institute) — upgraded to a 'major power'.

items.front: CCPI 2026 and Henley Passport Index 2026 — India's ranks?
items.back: CCPI 2026: 23rd (from 10th); Henley 2026: 80th.

items.front: INS Aridaman is India's third what?
items.back: Third indigenous SSBN (nuclear ballistic-missile submarine), after Arihant and Arighaat.

items.front: What is NISAR?
items.back: Joint NASA-ISRO earth-observation SAR satellite.

items.front: IAF retired which fighter in Sep 2025, after ~62 years?
items.back: MiG-21 (on 26 Sep 2025).

items.front: Who became India’s 15th Vice-President (Sep 2025)?
items.back: C. P. Radhakrishnan — early poll after Dhankhar’s resignation; oath 12 Sep 2025.

items.front: Where/when was the 18th BRICS Summit held?
items.back: Bharat Mandapam, New Delhi, 12-13 Sep 2026; New Delhi Declaration adopted.

items.front: When did the Economic Survey become a separate document from the Budget?
items.back: In 1964 (it first appeared with the Budget in 1950-51).

items.front: Are the 'Bharat Ratna Dr. Bhupen Hazarika National Awards' the Bharat Ratna?
items.back: No — they are separate cultural awards named after Hazarika (Nov 2025, Guwahati).

items.front: Why can no country be 1st in the CCPI?
items.back: The CCPI leaves its top 3 ranks vacant — no country is fully Paris-aligned.
